text.name: The Hanssen Leak
text.rules: Record "mole inside". SAE spends 2 points on one action. LIO's hand is shown to SAE. Draw from SAE's Contingency deck. If the result is 2 or less, record "mole caught", then LIO spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: FBI agent Robert Hanssen was arrested on 18 February 2001 after spying for the Soviet Union and Russia on and off since 1979; he was sentenced to life imprisonment.
